a.lede: Commerce secretary Howard Lutnick has been under attack for not blacklisting a company caught up in the Jensen Huang scandal. But Trump is on board with the policy.
a.title: The Nvidia Scandal Could Upend Chip Sales to China. Trump Wants to Keep Them Going

b.lede: The Justice and Commerce Departments have announced an investigation into Megaspeed over concerns that it may have been involved in the illegal export of Nvidia's AI hardware. The company was previously run by the woman officials have accused of being a Chinese spy while having an affair with Jensen Huang while he was Nvidia CEO.
b.title: US government confirms criminal investigation into Singapore company at the heart of Jensen Huang scandal
